description: Verify a SQLite backup. Runs a PRAGMA integrity check; if 'against' is given, also compares schema and row counts to a reference database. Returns a JSON report. Read-only. (Local files only.)

against.description: Optional local reference database to compare schema against

data.description: Also compare row counts per table

source.description: Local path to the backup database to verify

name: litescope_check

Passed.description: Overall pass/fail across every check performed.

Path.description: The backup database that was verified.

title: Verify backup integrity
